name: Valley of Dragons
description: A fantasy setting centered on the Valley of Dragons, where humans, elves, and dragons coexist and build alliances with other free peoples while confronting military and supernatural threats.

canon_policy.secondary_sources: current manuscript/clean-text Drive material when needed for provenance or clarification

core_facts: Humans, elves, and dragons coexist in the Valley of Dragons.
Dragons are ancient inhabitants and natural guardians and allies of the valley's peoples.
Elves are strongly associated with magic, knowledge, art, living architecture, and plantsmithing.
Humans are strongly associated with craftsmanship, trade, adaptability, and political and commercial life in River City.
The Dragon Rider Knights are a military order created in the era of the Dark God's invasion and led by three paladins.
After the events of Clash Under the Mountain, the Valley maintains a formal mutual-defense, diplomatic, trade, and knowledge-sharing alliance with the dwarven Kingdom of Khazad-Throm.
A permanent dwarven diplomatic and settlement presence exists in the Valley after Clash Under the Mountain.
